description: Use this when the user wants to merge PDF files, combine PDFs into one, join PDF pages, reorder PDF pages, take only some pages of each PDF, delete pages from a PDF, or rotate PDF pages. Takes 1 to 20 attached PDFs in attach order and an optional list of parts (file number, page ranges like "1-3, 7, 10-end", pages to skip, rotation 90/180/270), and returns one new PDF with the page plan and a check that the output page count, order, sizes and rotation match the plan. With one file, it can delete, reorder or rotate pages. Does not open password-protected PDFs, does not keep form fields editable (they are flattened), and does not edit text. Do not use for splitting one PDF into several files (use split_pdf).

files.description: The PDFs to merge, in order, e.g. cover.pdf, report.pdf, appendix.pdf.

download_url.description: Temporary download link for the file, supplied by ChatGPT.

file_name.description: Original file name if known, e.g. statement.pdf.

mime_type.description: Media type if known, e.g. application/pdf.

output_name.description: File name for the result, e.g. contract-signed-set.pdf. Default: merged.pdf.

parts.description: Optional page plan, in output order, e.g. [{"file":2,"pages":"1-3"},{"file":1,"pages":"all","rotate":90}]. Default: all pages of all files in attach order.

file.description: 1-based number of the attached file, in attach order, e.g. 2.

pages.description: Pages of that file to take, in order, e.g. "1-3, 7, 10-end". Default: all pages.

rotate.description: Extra clockwise rotation for these pages: 0, 90, 180 or 270, e.g. 90. Default 0.

skip.description: Pages of that file to leave out (delete), e.g. "4, 9". Optional.

name: merge_pdfs
title: Merge PDFs
